scientific_integrity: Proof by exact invariant-column decomposition, unipotent fixed spaces and a corner-power threshold. Bounded literature comparison; historical priority is provisional. No independent audit. The earlier 2007 radical-ring construction is cited as background; no day-resolved first-public date was asserted for that background publication.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns canonical brace left-action permutations, not all orbit invariants of the associated Yang--Baxter solution; the individual cycle census uses computable corner ranks, not a distribution over all brace elements. Computational checks cover only prime fields and small sizes; the proof holds for all prime powers.
title: Complete left-action cycle types and sharp exponent jumps in triangular radical braces
